description: Enskilda avlopp is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Malmö stad. Locations in Malmö where wastewater from buildings is treated at an individual sewage plant. Our location of individual drains is not always accurate, especially in residential areas. The coordinate point type attribute describes what was used to create the point. The center point of the property may be far from the actual drain. Coverage: Malmö stad. The portal shows the English title as "Individual drains" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Malmö stad. Its keywords include Vatten, geodata, karta, gis, map, Malmö stad. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
